Dalam masa yang sama, Sunny mencintai seorang penyanyi baharu yang bernama Natasha.

programme.title: Rahsia
programme.desc: Dihantui gangguan misteri, sepasang suami isteri mula mencari punca kepada gangguan tersebut. Profesor Hamdan dan Ramlah serta anak mereka, Saiful dan Marina berpindah ke sebuah banglo lama di tepi laut. Mereka hidup aman dan damai bersama di banglo tersebut. Namun tragedi melanda apabila Marina lemas di laut dan meninggal dunia - dari situlah bermulanya kejadian aneh.

programme.title: Jogho
programme.desc: Dendam menguasai masyarakat Melayu Patani di Thailand Selatan. Kalah dalam pertempuran lembu jantan, lawannya dibunuh yang juga saudara kepada Mamat - yang berjanji untuk membalas dendam bagi kematian saudaranya. Sifat dendam dalam masyarakat Melayu tetap mengalir kerana isteri Mamat, Minah gagal untuk menghentikan kitaran kejam itu.

programme.title: Salah Bapak
programme.desc: Jamil dan Osman terpaksa melalui pelbagai rintangan untuk menuntut hak mereka ke atas harta peninggalan Al-Sagof, bapa mereka yang telah meninggal dunia. Pak Joko ingin cuba membolot harta Al-Sagof lalu merancang pelbagai taktik kotor untuk mendapatkannya. Seroja, gadis yang menyewa tapak tanak bapa mereka untuk membuka warung turut terlibat apabila dia digunakan Pak Joko.

programme.title: Seru
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang sebuah produksi yang sedang membuat satu penggambaran filem seram bertajuk Jangan Bernafas. Semasa penggambaran berlangsung, secara tiba-tiba, pelbagai kejadian aneh dan peristiwa berlaku, diluar jangkaan mereka. Pada mulanya, mereka menganggap ia hanyalah rasukan biasa dan kru di sebalik pembikinan filem tersebut, ingin menjadikannya sebagai footage menarik untuk tujuan promosi filem tersebut. Namun, seorang demi seorang menjadi sasaran rasukan dan juga pembunuhan, menyebabkan keadaan menjadi tidak terkawal... tetapi kamera yang digunakan, masih terus merakamkan aksi yang terjadi.

programme.title: Talak
programme.desc: Johan dan Liza sering bertengkar sehingga membawa kepada penceraian. Tetapi setiap kali ianya terjadi, mereka akan merujuk kembali. Tanpa disedari, Johan telah pun melafazkan talak kepada Liza sebanyak tiga kali, ini menyebabkan mereka tidak boleh merujuk kembali. Johan terpaksa mencari lelaki yang boleh dipercayai untuk berkahwin dengan Liza supaya mereka boleh kembali bersama. Namun, malang menimpa apabila lelaki untuk tidak mahu melepaskan Liza.

programme.title: Mama Oh Mama
programme.desc: Ani, seorang perempuan yang berperwatakan liar sering melakukan perkara yang tidak dipersetujui oleh ibu bapanya . Dia sering mengunjungi kelab malam dan keluar bersama teman lelakinya . Walaupun dinasihati oleh orang gajinya, Ani tetap tidak berubah sikap.

programme.title: Sepi Itu Indah
programme.desc: Liz seorang gadis remaja yang tinggal di Terengganu bersama bapanya Pak Chad, bekas pejuang kemerdekaan berhaluan kiri. Dia bercita-cita untuk menjadi seorang penulis terkenal. Selepas kematian Pak Chad, Liz meninggalkan kampung halamannya dan pergi ke rumah Datuk Kamarul, rakan seperjuangan bapanya yang kini sudah berjaya dalam bidang politik dan perniagaan di Petaling Jaya. Datuk Kamarul mempunyai dua orang anak iaitu Zamri dan Zaiton. Liz kemudiannya menjadi anak angkat kepada Datuk Kamarul dan menyambung persekolahannya dalam aliran sastera. Kehadiran Liz dalam keluarga itu telah membuatkan hubungan Zamri dan kekasihnya Ita, menjadi renggang.

programme.title: Imigran
programme.desc: Faridah, pekerja warga asing terlibat dalam kes jenayah apabila telah menjadi saksi kes pembunuhan. programme.desc: Mengisahkan Raziah, seorang suri rumah yang menjadi wanita berdikari dan penyara keluarga selepas kematian suaminya. Tidak mahu pasrah, Raziah berusaha mencari pekerjaan dan membina kejayaan demi memulihkan rasa hormat komuniti terhadapnya.

programme.title: Prebet Sapu
programme.desc: Pada 2018, Aman berpindah dari Pahang ke Kuala Lumpur mengejar impian menjadi penulis, namun hidupnya penuh kesusahandihalau dari bilik sewa, terpaksa tidur di kereta, dan menjadi pemandu e-hailing secara haram kerana buta warna. Hidupnya berubah apabila bertemu Bella, seorang penumpang yang menawarkan tempat tinggal dengan syarat Aman menjadi pemandu peribadinya. Persahabatan terjalin, tetapi konflik menanti. Bagaimana nasib kedua-dua jiwa miskin bandar ini akan terungkai?

programme.title: Sifu Tongga
programme.desc: Dua lelaki dengan personaliti dan cara hidup yang sangat berbeza secara tidak sengaja terlibat dalam pelbagai situasi huru-hara. Walaupun sering bergaduh dan tidak sehaluan, mereka terpaksa bekerjasama untuk menyelesaikan masalah yang membawa mereka ke dalam dunia penuh aksi, kekacauan dan komedi yang tidak dijangka.

programme.title: One, Two, Trivia
programme.desc: Sebuah program yang merungkai fakta-fakta menarik yang tersimpan dalam filem-filem klasik tempatan

programme.title: 6 Jilake
programme.desc: Sekumpulan samseng upahan yang dikenali sebagai 6 Jilake ditugaskan oleh syarikat penjajah untuk menguasai lombong bijih timah di negeri Perak pada abad ke-18. Namun mereka berhadapan dengan seorang pendekar kampung yang hebat dan sukar dikalahkan, lalu tercetus konflik besar penuh aksi dan jenaka.

programme.title: Melawan Takdir
programme.desc: Filem ni kisahkan perjalanan hidup Quraisy Mathar sendiri pengarah filem ni. Ia mengangkat pengalaman hidupnya yang penuh cabaran sejak kecil kehilangan orang tersayang, jatuh bangun dalam hidup, sampai berjaya jadi seorang sineas. Cerita ni tunjuk bagaimana semangat, doa, dan keyakinan boleh buat seseorang bangkit walaupun diuji dengan pelbagai takdir yang pahit.

programme.title: Cincin Pusaka
programme.desc: Alina dan Sofian adalah dua beradik yang saling cemburu, berlumba mengalahkan satu sama lain sejak kecil. Setelah kematian nenek, mereka berebut untuk memiliki cincin pusaka nenek yang kononnya mempunyai magis tertentu. Tetapi pelbagai halangan terjadi untuk mereka mewarisinya. Mampukah mereka menghadapi segala rintangan demi sebentuk cincin pusaka?

programme.title: Madu Murni

Atas cadangan rakannya, dia mengambil isteri kedua, Yati, lalu tercetus pelbagai konflik dan situasi lucu yang menguji rumah tangga mereka.

programme.title: Longkai

Semua kenderaan yang ditunda oleh mereka akan dibawa ke bengkel Rimau. Walaupun dia seorang wanita, Rimau berperwatakan sedikit tomboy dan lasak. Rimau telah jatuh cinta dengan Bada, tetapi dia tidak pernah berani untuk meluahkan perasaannya walaupun dia nampak tough.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter (像母亲,像女儿)
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time. programme.title: Mystic Nine Whats On Today ((Mystic Nine 即将上映电影))
programme.desc: Mystic Nine tells the story of Zhang Qishan William Chan and Wu Laogou Joseph Zeng joining forces with Huo Xiangu Chen Yao and the other members of the Nine Gates to embark on an adventure amidst renewed turmoil in Changsha. A mysterious disappearance of Unit 401 uncovers a shocking secret buried for a century. Life-or-death choices, brotherhood, sectarian duty, and national righteousness intertwine. The members of the Nine Gates use their blood and sacrifice to protect their homeland and overcome difficulties together.

programme.title: Big Feast Duel ((美食強人))
programme.desc: With expert evaluations from renowned chefs and rigorous testing from food connoisseurs, forty restaurants compete to become the top ten culinary representatives! TV King Moses Chan and TV Queen Katy Kung transform into Food Guru, meticulously selecting the strongest food guide for the Greater Bay Area based on ten themes including baked pork chop rice, wonton noodles, French toast, roast pigeon, hamburgers, and shrimp dumplings. programme.title: Neighborhood Treasures Sr.7 (邻居财库)
programme.desc: Sammy and Kitty, this quirky duo, reunite on screen, this time as secret agent leaders, delivering hilarious clips from Taiwan, Japan, and Hong Kong to the audience. programme.title: Big Boys Club ((Big Boys Club兄弟幫 - 外星來客))
programme.desc: Big Boys Club is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friendsBob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils 2021 ((天龙八部))
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng played by Yang Youning, the leader of the Beggars Sect Duan Yu played by Bai Shu, the prince of Dali and Xu Zhu played by Zhang Tianyang, a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by love.

programme.title: Vital Lifeline ((最强生命线))
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. The Strongest Lifeline helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the Sanfu herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health. (城市居民往往经历着繁忙的生活和高度压力,这使他们更容易受到健康问题的影响。最强的生命线帮助你解开健康的秘密。首先,该方案在常见的城市疼痛问题上有四大系列,包括头痛、肩部和颈部疼痛、背部疼痛和联合疼痛。每集都邀请医疗专家解释这些病症的原因,以及物理治疗师和锻炼专家进行适当的锻炼。随着东西方医学结合的趋势日益增长,甚至美国游泳冠军迈克尔·菲尔普斯也使用杯式疗法来缓解疼痛。因此,每集都包括传统的中国医学诊断,辅之以针线、杯子和Sanfu草药补丁疗法等疗法,这些疗法在最热的夏季特别合适。此外,中国医药从业人员分享了营养汤的食谱,所有这些都有助于调节和改善你的健康。)

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils 2021 ((天龙八部))
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng played by Yang Youning, the leader of the Beggars Sect Duan Yu played by Bai Shu, the prince of Dali and Xu Zhu played by Zhang Tianyang, a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by love.

The team delves into the heart of the restaurants, uncovering their little-known culinary stories. A tasting team composed of renowned chefs, well-known food critics, and discerning celebrities will also secretly visit restaurants, bringing back their honest reviews to the studio. After a round of debate and critique, the top-rated restaurants for each theme will be crowned! Viewers can also vote for their favorite dish.

programme.title: EXTRA ((E.T.外星人))
programme.desc: Report important news about Hong Kong, cross-strait, and international affairs. Stay updated every night with the latest news from Hong Kongs entertainment industry, as well as film and entertainment news from around the world. We report on the newest developments of artists, promotions for TV series and movies, highlights from concerts, and coverage of grand award ceremonies. We even travel abroad to cover major entertainment events, track international movie stars, and conduct exclusive interviews with well-known singers, actors, and television personalities familiar to our audienceensuring you can instantly grasp the latest happenings and news in the world of film and entertainment. (报道有关香港,跨海峡和国际事务的重要新闻.每天晚上都会随时了解香港娱乐业的最新消息,以及来自世界各地的电影和娱乐新闻.我们报道艺术家的最新发展,电视剧和电影的促销,音乐会的亮点,以及大奖典礼的报道.我们甚至出国观看大型娱乐活动,追踪国际电影明星,并与知名歌手,演员和电视人物进行独家访谈.)

programme.title: News Roundup ((现在不是出轨的问题))

programme.title: Lelio PoPo (莱利奥波波)
programme.desc: Former radio DJs KK and Ah Luke were once hugely popular, but their bad attitudes and eccentric behaviour got them fired. Desperate for a comeback, they audition for a new radio station searching for elderly female hosts. Disguising themselves as old ladies, the pair unexpectedly land the job and spark a series of hilarious misadventures. (从前的DJ KK和Ah Luke电台曾经非常受欢迎,但他们的不良态度和以极端为中心的行为使他们被解雇了。 迫不及待地回访,他们为寻找老年女性主机的新电台试镜。 假扮自己是老太太,这对夫妇出乎意料地找到了工作,引发了一系列可笑的冒险。)

programme.title: Sons of the Neon Night ((风林火山))
programme.desc: Set in a snowbound, surreal Hong Kong, a tycoon who also secretly rules the drug trade is killed in an explosion, plunging the city into chaos. With police paralysed and the family businesses in turmoil, his youngest son vows to dismantle the familys empire, but is thwarted by his fugitive brother and his fathers followers fighting for control.

programme.title: Tainted Love ((无法抗拒的爱))
programme.desc: Office lady Zhou Ran falls victim to an online dating love scam and is cheated of 550,000 yuan. Following faint clues left by the scammer, Zhou Ran comes to a small coastal town and encounters two young men. She gradually discovers that these two men have hidden the clues of the scam, and sets out on her revenge plan. (办公室的Zhou Ran女士成为网上约会爱情骗局的受害者,并被550,000元骗骗。 在骗徒留下微弱线索后,Zhou Ran来到一个小沿海城镇,遇到了两个年轻人。 她逐渐发现这两个男人隐藏了骗局的线索,并提出了她的报复计划。)

programme.title: My Date With A Vampire ((我和僵尸有个约会))
programme.desc: Demon slayer Ma Siu Ling crosses paths with the mysterious detective Fong Tin Yau while investigating a series of bizarre cases. As distrust gives way to an unlikely alliance, the two uncover long-buried secrets and face powerful supernatural forces in a battle against the dark conspiracy threatening the city.

programme.title: Someone Like Me (像我这样的人)
programme.desc: Mui, who lives with cerebral palsy, longs for connection and meets volunteer Kin. As their wounded souls grow closer, she begins to rethink love and her self-worth beyond the limits of her body, discovering the courage to embrace life and intimacy on her own terms.

programme.title: A Guilty Conscience ((沈默杀机))
programme.desc: Due to the negligence of sharp-tongued barrister Adrian, his innocent client is convicted of murder and sentenced to 17 years in jail. An opportunity to appeal the case and free his client arises a few years later, but in order to right his wrong, he must fight against one of the most powerful families in Hong Kong for justice to prevail. (由于Adrian大律师的尖锐疏忽,他的无辜当事人被判犯有谋杀罪并被判处17年监禁。 几年后,他有机会上诉并释放他的当事人,但为了纠正他的错误,他必须同香港最有权势的家庭之一斗争,以伸张正义。)

programme.title: Shining For One Thing ((一闪一闪亮星星))
programme.desc: Zhang Wan Sen plans to confess his crush on Lin Bei Xing after the college entrance exam, but an accident changes everything tragically. As Zhang feels helpless and devastated, he fortuitously travels back in time with Lin before the accident happens. Can he make amends and convey his regrets this time?

programme.title: Shadows ((影子))
programme.desc: Ching is a forensic psychiatrist who has the power to enter a persons subconscious mind. In her latest case, she suspects that another psychiatrist is responsible for a brutal murder-cum-suicide case involving a social worker. In the investigation process, Ching finds herself under suspicion instead, as she comes face-to-face with a past trauma

programme.title: Detective Dee And Nine-storey Demon Building
programme.desc: A series of strange incidents happen at the Tangs demon building but Detective Dee finds no clue. Dee finds the master of the family suspicious when he speaks with him, and when the eldest daughter Miss Tang secretly informs Dee about Mr Tangs strange behavior and the fact that she is kept under surveillance, Dee vows to unveil the truth.

programme.title: Last Suspect ((拯救嫌疑人))
programme.desc: Lawyer Chen receives a mysterious call demanding her to defend a murder suspect after her daughter is kidnapped, and is told that she can only save her daughter by winning the case. As she starts investigation with the police and evidence emerges, Chen discovers the truth and reveals the mastermind. Can she rescue her daughter in time?

programme.title: Alls Well Ends Well Too ((花田喜事))
programme.desc: Another super comedy directed by Clifton Ko about more farcical couplings, mistaken identities, infidelities, and arranged marriages set in the Sung Dynasty. (另一个由克利夫顿·科导演的超级喜剧,讲述了更多的刺情侣,错误的身份,不忠,和安排的婚姻,发生在朝.)

programme.title: Crypto Storm ((反贪风暴之加密危机))
programme.desc: ICAC investigation officer Lok sets up a special team to investigate a corruption case involving a banks top executives use of cryptocurrency to manipulate the trading market. When the banks chairman is kidnapped and kidnappers demand ransom in crypto coins, Lok connects the dots and vows to hunt down the mastermind behind both crimes.

programme.title: MuMu ((快乐乡颂))
programme.desc: Mumu, a cheerful seven-year-old girl, lives with her deaf father in a deaf community and connects him to the outside world. However, their peaceful life is disrupted when her estranged mother reappears, pushing Mumu into the hearing world. Meanwhile, her father becomes ensnared by a gang that exploits the deaf to commit crimes. (穆穆(Mumu)是一位快乐的七岁女孩,她与聋哑父亲一起生活在聋哑社区,并将他与外界连接起来。 然而,当她离家出走的母亲再次出现,将穆穆推入听力世界时,他们的和平生活就中断了。 与此同时,她父亲被一个利用聋哑人犯罪团伙的暴怒。)

programme.title: Alls Well Ends Well Extended Version (完美结局完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完美完)
programme.desc: In this beloved Hong Kong comedy, the three Chang brothers living with their parents learn that love blossoms with nurture, but withers when taken for granted through haste, deceit, and selfishness. This extended version features an additional shootout scene that was omitted from the original theatrical release during Lunar New Year 2016. (在这部深受喜爱的香港喜剧中,与父母住在一起的三兄弟学会了爱情在培养中勃发展,但在忙,欺骗和自私中被视为理所当然时会枯竭.这部扩展版还包含了2016年农历新年期间原来的剧场上映中遗漏的额外射击场景.)

programme.title: Cold War ((冷战风云录))
programme.desc: A hijacking of a police van occurs when the Police Commissioner is away from Hong Kong. Deputy Commissioner Lee leads a rescue operation code-named Cold War. Fellow Deputy Commissioner Sean moves to take control from Lee as he thinks Lee is emotionally affected by his son being held hostage, but the efforts end up threatening both their reputation. (警方专员离开香港后,便发生劫持警车事件。 李副局长领导了一个代号为冷战的救援行动。 肖恩副局长副局长西恩(Sean)试图控制李(Lee),因为他认为李(Lee)因儿子被扣为人质在情感上受到影响,但他的所作所为最终威胁到他们的声誉。)

programme.title: Shes Got No Name ((酱园弄·翻案))
programme.desc: In 1945 Shanghai, a gruesome murder shocks Jiang Yuan Nong. Frail woman Zhan Zhou Shi, driven to despair by years of domestic abuse, kills and dismembers her husband, then remains at the scene to surrender. The case seems clear-cut, yet remains riddled with doubt. As the truth unravels, a shocking reversal rewrites everyones fate.

programme.title: 8 Bucks Tycoon ((8块钱富豪))
programme.desc: When a struggling painter receives a magical wallet that endlessly produces RM8 notes, his life transforms from hardship to luxury. However, is this miracle truly a blessing or a hidden curse? (当一个苦扎的画家收到一个无休止地产生RM8笔钱包时,他的生活从困难转变为奢品.)

programme.title: Hex after Hex ((邪完再邪))
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular Venom Lo Meng. (绝对是这样一个的鬼魂,却是这样一个的鬼魂! 邪教经典导演Kuei Chih-hung用这个惊人的恐怖浪漫戏剧,)

programme.title: Ten Tigers Of Kwang Tung ((广东十虎与后五虎))
programme.desc: The Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung is a group of anti-Ching martial artists who have killed a Ching official. Years later, when five disciples and descendants of Ten Tigers meet one night, one of them is killed by the son of the late Ching official who returns with a vengeance. They must fight against him to protect the Ten Tigers clan

programme.title: Na Cha And The Seven Devils ((梅山收七怪))
programme.desc: While stealing one magical peach from a mystic tree in Heaven, Little Na Cha accidentally drops seven others on Earth, which transformed seven different animals into seven devils. Na Cha must hunt the devils down in ten days or his father will be punished by the King of Heaven. Can Na Cha complete his mission?

programme.title: Marco Polo ((马可波罗))
programme.desc: Mongolian emperor Kublai Khan is being assassinated while meeting with the Italian explorer Marco Polo. Marco Polo is appointed to lead the troops for the emperor to wipe out the anti-Mongol rebels. Yet, he is touched by these rebels who are resisting the Mongolian invasion of their homeland. Will Marco Polo stay loyal to the emperor?

programme.title: The Human Goddess ((仙女下凡))
programme.desc: Seventh Sister, a curious fairy from heaven, descends to 1970s Hong Kong. Lost in an unfamiliar world, she is rescued by Tung Chi Lap, who runs a debt-ridden orphanage. When a tycoon plots to seize the land, she uses her powers to protect it, and an unlikely romance begins. (第七修女,一位来自天堂的好奇仙女,降至1970年代的香港。 迷失在一个陌生的世界中,她被一个负债累累的孤儿院的东志拉普拯救。 当一个大亨用地夺取土地时,她利用自己的力量保护土地,而一个不可能发生的浪漫开始。)

programme.title: The Silver Fox ((银狐))
programme.desc: Hsia Wu and Sima Chau are adopted sons of an escort master. Greed drives Sima Chau to murder his master and disfigure Hsia Wu. Wounded, Hsia Wu flees with his young daughter, while his pregnant wife is raped and left unconscious. He raises his daughter in hatred, training her into the fearsome Silver Fox and sending her out for revenge.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost ((鬼屋丽人))
programme.desc: It is love beyond the grave, as a young scholar and his beautiful lover are torn apart forever by his dastardly uncle and his friend, who drive the girl to commit suicide... but with death comes revenge for the enchanting ghost. A spooky yet heart-wrenching tale... (爱是超越坟墓的, 年轻学者和他的美丽的情人 永远被他卑鄙的叔叔和朋友撕裂...)

programme.title: Chinatown Kid ((唐人街小子))
programme.desc: After getting into trouble with a local gangster, Chui Ho, in Hong Kong, Tam Dong flees to San Francisco and manages to get a job in a restaurant in Chinatown. Tam Dong finds himself embroiled with the gangsters again in San Francisco, and has to fight Chui Ho when the two meet again...

programme.title: Raw Passions ((裸血))
programme.desc: Mrs Lins husband and his friend both have affairs with a belly dancer Sasa, and are both blackmailed by her. Sasa is stabbed one day and her brother shows up asking for money. A mysterious man also claims he can offer evidence for cash to help Lins husband. Lin has to unveil the deceit, double-crosses and blackmailing before she is in danger too! (林夫夫和他的朋友都和一个肚子舞者萨萨发生了情侣关系,两人都被她勒索.萨萨有一天被刺伤,她的兄弟出现要求钱.一个神秘的人还声称他可以提供现金证据来帮助林夫.)

programme.title: The Venus Tear Diamond ((钻石艳盗))
programme.desc: Legendary rival jewel thieves Fragrant Night and Nocturnal Earl travel to Japan to steal the famous Venus Tear Diamond. They fall quickly in love at first sight, without knowing the other person is their rival and is after the same prize. Who will get the diamond, and will it mean the end of their new found love? (传奇的竞争对手珠宝盗窃者香水之夜和夜间伯爵前往日本偷走着著名的金星眼钻石. 他们一目睹就很快就恋爱了,而不知道另一个人是他们的竞争对手,并追求同样的奖励.谁将获得钻石,这将意味着他们新发现的爱情结束吗?)

programme.title: Tragic Commitment ((没有老公的日子))
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer 1M for her baby... (当一位医生的丈夫东先生在一次事故中受致命伤时,他向她透露了他与小黑的婚外情,他与小黑怀孕了。 尽管背叛的破坏和丈夫最终死亡,但她婆婆还是施加压力,要她忍受小黑,为她的孩子提供1M。)

programme.title: Scandal ((丑闻))
programme.desc: The roguish scamp Zhen and his best friend Chia collects proof of corruption from the officials in this comedy-drama. After a string of blackmailing, they end up in positions of power, but what is to happen next? (这场喜剧中的官员们收集了腐败的证据。 经过一连串的勒索后,他们最终成了掌权者,但接下来会发生什么呢?)

programme.title: The Duel of the Century ((陆小凤之决战前后))
programme.desc: A duel has been arranged at the Forbidden City between two formidable swordsmen of the martial world, Ye Gu Cheng and Xi Men Chui Xue. Lu Xiao Feng smells something fishy about the duel as the two swordsmen never met and do not have any conflicts. He decides to investigate more with Hua Man Lou, and eventually uncovers some hidden conspiracies

programme.title: The Adulteress (淫妇)
programme.desc: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, shes soon framed for her husbands murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of her woes in this emotional suspense (更糟糕的是,她很快就被强奸犯,当地地方法官的儿子,陷害丈夫谋杀了。 即便如此,在这种情绪悬念中,她的痛苦也并非结束。)

programme.title: The Fake Ghost Catchers ((鬼画符))
programme.desc: Huan Zhus ghost seeks help from Fake Ghost Catchers Bao Tuo and Zhou Peng, after a jealous suitors ghost seeks vengeance by murdering her and now targeting her sister. Together with actor Wu Shun Chao who possesses a supernatural talent, they unite to protect Huan Zhus sister from both mortal and spectral threats.

programme.title: Long Road To Gallantry ((游侠情))
programme.desc: Tu Meng Fei makes his way to the world after completing his kung fu training. En route, he rescues Mu Wan Erh and Li San Nan from a band of thugs and later learnt of a 20-year conflict between the evil Thunder Gang Chief Leng Tian Lei and the Dragon Sect. Mus lost father is none other than the Thunder Gang Chief, who also killed Lis father (在路上,他救了穆万埃尔和李桑南从一群暴徒中,后来了解到恶毒雷团长天莱和龙宗派之间的20年冲突.)

programme.title: The Convict Killer ((插翅难飞))
programme.desc: After spending fifteen years in prison on trumped-up charges for drug smuggling, the martial arts master Teng Piao embarks on a journey to take revenge on the person who sets him up - Black Leopard. Unfortunately for Piao, no one knows the real identity of Black Leopard, except that there is a black leopard tattoo on his chest.

programme.title: Double Bliss ((双喜临门))
programme.desc: Dong and Chu plan to get married but their families who are lifelong rivals, disapproved. They decide to fake suicide and eventually get both of their parents to settle their differences and approve the marriage. Concurrently, a record company announces that they will release Dongs songs, leading to double bliss for the couple. (东中和朱计划结婚,但他们的家族是终身竞争对手,不赞成。 他们决定假自杀,最终让父母双方解决分歧并批准婚姻。 同时,一家唱片公司宣布他们将发行东斯歌曲,为夫妇带来双欢。)

programme.title: The Boxer From The Temple ((佛都有火))
programme.desc: A young monk, The Kid, was expelled from the temple due to his crazy ways. After leaving the temple, he fights a cruel bandits son and befriends a prostitute. As he fights for justice, his Crazy Lo Han Fist improves with every fight.

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall ((王昭君))
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Huns warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself. (王赵军拒绝贿赂帝国画家,因此他画了一张她丑陋的肖像,阻止她被皇帝选中,直到他们见面。 画家最终流亡在外,并阴谋让王朝嫁给洪军阀,以报仇。 皇帝拒绝了这一提议,挑起一场战争,只有王王自祭才能避免战争。)

programme.title: Periya Kudumbam
programme.desc: Three brothers live harmoniously until their cousins exploit a vulnerable situation and join forces with others to try and break them apart.

programme.title: Mohini
programme.desc: Vaishnavi and Sandeep, an engaged couple, face chaos when Vaishnavi is possessed by a vengeful lookalike, threatening their relationship and future.

programme.title: Thirunaal
programme.desc: Blade, a henchman for a local gangster, Naaga, falls in love with Vidhya, the daughter of a factory owner. He has to choose between supporting her father and his boss, who are rivals.

programme.title: House Mates
programme.desc: Newlyweds Karthik and Anu move into an old apartment where strange events disrupt their lives, pushing them to uncover a paranormal mystery linked to another nearby family.

programme.title: Akhanda 2
programme.desc: As biological warfare threatens the country, a scientist seeks a cure. But when dangerous forces target her, a warrior returns to defend humanity.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.title: Veerame Vaagai Soodum
programme.desc: A normal man from a middle-class family questioning the authorities for abusing their powers.

programme.title: Iru Mugan
programme.desc: Following the attack on the Indian Embassy in Malaysia, Akhilan, an ex-agent, is assigned to track down the culprit. His investigations lead him to his old foe who has now developed a hazardous drug.

programme.title: Aakashaganga 2
programme.desc: When Arathi decides to expose an ashram, which claims to help people communicate with the dead, an evil spirit Akashganga, returns to haunt her.

programme.title: Sarkarin Elam
programme.desc: A finance agent is conned by his love interest and travels to India to get his money back from her influential father, who is a Member of Parliament and industrialist.

programme.title: Pheonix
programme.desc: Young Surya, accused of political murder, endures deadly plots in a juvenile reform school while struggling to survive the brutal realities of life behind bars daily.

programme.title: Kuttram 23
programme.desc: ACP Vetrimaaran unravels a crime racket involving medical professionals. However, his task becomes harder every day as the case becomes murkier and complex.

programme.title: Baalveer
programme.desc: Baal Veer is taken to a fairyland where he is blessed with special powers by six fairies, each having her own unique traits. He uses these powers to help his friends, including Manav and Meher.

programme.desc: A superhero child and his special car, Super Speedo, go on adventiures to save the world from villains.

programme.title: Rare Survivors - Chinas Iconic Wildlife ((最美华夏：中国的野生国宝))
programme.desc: Mist swirls around the base of Shanghais skyline. From the city, tigers and monkeys seem as unreal and distant as dragons and mermaids emerging through the mist. Yet they exist as rare survivors in an extraordinary and diverse landscape. From snow leopards to wild horses, and from alligators to elephants, Chinas iconic wildlife is a lot more than just pandas. (上海山顶的云雾环绕着上海的天空线。 从城市看,老虎和猴子似乎和龙和美人鱼一样不真实和遥远。 然而,它们却像稀有的幸存者一样存在于不同寻常的地貌中。 从雪豹到野马,从鳄鱼到大象,中国的象形野生动物远不止是熊猫。)

programme.title: 仙女下凡

programme.title: 玉面飞狐

programme.title: 鬼屋丽人

programme.title: 唐人街功夫小子
programme.desc: 青年谭东独自从大陆来港投靠祖父，因与黑社会人物徐豪结怨而遭陷害，迫于无奈偷渡到三藩市东在唐人街饭店觅得工作，后来又因打抱不平而再牵涉入黑帮恩怨中东更重遇徐豪，二人展开连场恶战

programme.title: 裸血
programme.desc: 凌波的丈夫高远及其友王侠，均与肚皮舞女郎孟莉有染，孟借此勒索二人；后孟被杀，高成嫌疑犯，另孟之兄翟诺，亦向高勒索；而凌在家，也接见了谷峰，他声言有为高洗罪的证据，但要索钱；王妻李香君借贷给凌... 究竟谁是杀孟真凶？

programme.title: 钻石艳盗
programme.desc: 两大珠宝盗贼夜来香和夜爵士前往日本，意图偷去维纳斯的眼泪巨钻二人见面后即坠入爱河，却不知道原来对方同为盗取巨钻的竞敌最后谁会得到巨钻？二人的恋情又会否无疾而终？

programme.title: 没有老公的日子
programme.desc: 黄太太独力抚养儿子Alex成人，与媳妇阿彤一起生活岂料Alex意外逝世，死前道出外遇女友黑仔已怀有身孕结果三名没有老公的女人同住一室...

programme.title: 丑闻
programme.desc: 在河北省某贪污成风的小县内，流浪汉甄明与贾亮因掌握一众县官的贪污和丑闻证据，得以顺水推舟假扮县长，把各官员玩弄于股掌之中，峰回路转，结局却出人意表全片除带出人生如戏的黑色幽默，也狠狠地鞭挞为官者残民以自肥的无耻行为

programme.title: 陆小凤之决战前后
programme.desc: 两大武林剑客叶孤城与西门吹雪将于紫禁城决斗陆小凤忖度二人素末谋面，又无利益冲突，无须决斗，猜想当中一定事有蹊跷于是，他决定和花满楼前往京城调查清楚，却发现当中隐藏的阴谋...

programme.title: 杨乃武与小白菜
programme.desc: 剧情讲述，知县之子刘子和，垂涎葛小大之妻小白菜，用迷药将其奸污刘子和事后恐东窗事发，用砒霜毒死葛小大葛死后，镇内流言四起，知县为救爱儿，设计嫁祸小白菜婚前恋人杨乃武乃武被苦打成招，其姐杨淑英不忍见弟含冤而死，到刑部要求翻案......

programme.title: 鬼画符
programme.desc: 周鹏被神捕诸葛森追杀，投靠表兄包妥林家大少奶被男鬼杜洛所杀，要求鹏二人带其鬼魂上路，到开封找公孙先生消灭杜鬼魂鹏以大少奶的鬼符在赌场赢取路费，更与戏子吴顺超一同上路...

programme.title: 游侠情
programme.desc: 杜孟飞奉命下山闯荡江湖，途中救出遭黑道中人捉拿的沐婉儿，杜挺身相救，沐万分感激未几，杜又救出被黑道中人围攻的少女李赛男及后，杜无意中得知一段二十年前的江湖恩怨，黑道首领是李之杀父仇人，而沐则是黑道首领失散的女儿...

programme.title: 插翅难飞
programme.desc: 邓彪因为黑货买卖失手，遂逼江湖人物高明供出从中陷害者，高明说出乃黑豹所为后，即被开枪杀死，邓彪因此被判监禁十五年他出狱后即找黑豹报仇，却遇上势力庞大的葛八爷干扰；同时商琳为寻失踪十五年的丈夫，欲找邓彪查问黑豹下落，但两人仅听过黑豹其名，从未见其人，究竟黑豹是谁？

programme.title: 双喜临门
programme.desc: 朱国栋和李明珠本打算结婚，无奈双方父母为多年死对头，所以坚决反对婚事于是二人不惜假装自杀有见及此双方家长最终冰释前嫌，答应二人成婚此时，唱片公司宣布会为出栋的歌曲版，最终可谓双喜临门

programme.title: 夜守
programme.desc: 一场可怕车祸后失忆的王人杰，找到一份废弃大厦的夜间警卫工作当晚交接的老守卫举止怪异，数小时后竟陈尸密室，王人杰瞬间成为头号嫌疑犯诡异事件接连发生，旧日恩怨与冤魂浮现，三只厉鬼如约而至，揭开一场蓄谋已久的复仇计划接踵而来的厄运，究竟是命运还是诅咒？

programme.title: 青蛙王子
programme.desc: 此喜剧在夏威夷开始，富家子为人腼腆，追女乏术，好友充当其爱情顾问，带他四出泡妞，却碰得一鼻子灰，闹出连场笑话

programme.title: 军火大劫案
programme.desc: 特工阿文被安排潜伏于东南亚的军火商旗下，寻找其手中的一批军火炸药并将其销毁当他终于找到该批军火后，却遭到不明匪徒袭击为防止灾难发生，阿文决定与他的特工搭档阿琼合力夺回军火

programme.title: 鬼马飞人
programme.desc: 阿B为一名中学的体育教师，其执教之学校篮足球队成绩甚差，学校下令他务必赢得校际比赛冠军，否则将撤换教练阿B因头痛，误服同事研制之神药，变成超人，令球队屡次创造奇迹...

programme.title: 僵尸家族
programme.desc: 一群盗墓的考古学家意外发现一个保存完好的僵尸家族，计画将他们贩卖至黑市牟利岂料在运送途中，不慎撕下封印僵尸的纸符，让沉睡的亡灵苏醒逃窜然而，当地中医师林正英挺身而出，誓要将它们彻底剿灭

programme.title: 霹雳先锋
programme.desc: 张铁柱是一名出色的警长，他刚烈的办案风格却遭到上司和同僚的不满当他意外发现偷车贼伟仔为追捕持枪劫匪的关键人物，两人不得不携手将罪犯绳之以法

programme.title: 开棺
programme.desc: 消失三年的鬼手及其盗墓团伙重现江城，再次下墓摸金怎料四名盗墓贼在开棺时遇惊魂邪煞，逃离后又接连惨死家中最终古墓尸毒和针孔成为留给员警沈春合仅有的线索，看似普通的盗墓案，瞬间扑朔迷离疑点重重

programme.title: 醉拳
programme.desc: 年轻气盛的黄飞鸿因招惹地方恶霸之子，被父亲送去跟随醉拳大师苏乞儿受训一年当父亲揭发恶霸欲将国有矿产卖给日本人的阴谋后，顿成刺杀目标为救父并阻止交易，飞鸿施展自创的醉拳，击败众杀手

programme.title: 让子弹飞
programme.desc: 悍匪张牧之劫持火车，冒充新任县长强横进驻鹅城本想靠升官发财大捞一笔，却撞上了只手遮天的当地地头蛇恶霸黄四郎在满嘴谎言的骗子师爷马邦德的利益周旋下，黑白两道展开一场智力与火力的巅峰对决在这场荒诞的杀戮游戏中，且看子弹如何飞往最终的真相

programme.title: 特务迷城
programme.desc: 天赋异禀的健身器材店员小北跨国寻亲，意外卷入特务父亲遗留的谜局，远赴土耳其追寻身世与巨额遗产，却不料陷入国际反恐阴谋面对炭疽病毒引发的全球危机，小北在土耳其街头展开惊心动魄的跨国大逃亡在重重谜局的考验中，他突破自我极限，从平凡蜕变为守护世界的孤胆英雄

programme.title: 灵幻先生
programme.desc: 江湖术士茅山明无法驱除复仇的怨灵，只得与他的鬼同伴一起逃脱他们躲进一个村庄后，遇到了意图灭绝人类的邪恶女魔头于是，茅山明与师父九叔携手合作，对抗这位威胁村民的魔头他们能否战胜黑暗势力，赢得最终的胜利？

programme.title: 大内密探零零发
programme.desc: 零零发是宫廷四大高手之一，专职保卫皇帝的安全虽然不谙武功，却有着不寻常的嗜好：打造超越时代的发明皇上被掳后，他靠着自己的过人发明救驾

programme.title: 龙的传人
programme.desc: 青年周小龙离开纯朴的离岛到香港发展他的师叔欺骗小龙参加桌球比赛，并以他父亲的地皮作为赌注小龙最后输掉了比赛，幸得他青梅竹马的朋友毛毛鼓励，把自家的田地也作为赌注小龙最后能否把自己的土地赢回来？

programme.title: 游龙戏凤
programme.desc: 英俊潇洒的富商程仲森曾有过三段失败的婚姻当他遇见在赌场担任荷官闲暇时兼职舞蹈表演的米兰，两人迅速坠入爱河然而，当他提出签署婚前协议书的那一刻，这段刚萌芽的恋情随即面临严峻考验

programme.title: 曼谷风云
programme.desc: 地下拳手林枫因拒绝替曼谷黑帮打黑拳，因此被追杀他虽成功逃脱，却失去记忆当林枫开展其新生活时，却被黑帮发现行踪，并找来绝顶打手对付他期间林枫忽然回复记忆，并誓要将黑帮歼灭

programme.title: 贼王之王

programme.desc: 东张西望星期一至日，紧贴追踪社会大事趣闻逸事，并报导娱乐圈最新动态艺人消息，以及剧集宣传和花絮今日突发环节为大家追踪即日热门新闻；专题环节，深入探讨大众关心的时事社会及民生问题，并访问相关的专家

programme.title: 爱．回家之三代同糖 第64集
programme.desc: 公关女皇唐万里吴若希饰独力照顾Gen Z女儿唐芯李茵彤饰，控制欲极强万里的母亲唐曹嘉冰车婉婉饰半生相夫教子，忽然觉醒，由加拿大返港，决心寻回失落时光，更搬入万里家中

programme.title: 全城热话璀璨之城结局夜 直播 璀璨之城 第20集
programme.desc: 尚利锋集团主席官志琛姜大卫饰在澳门雄霸一方，这商界巨人安排两子官孝贤张智霖饰官孝君吴卓羲饰，出任集团联席行政总裁，平起平坐

programme.title: 九门 第23集
programme.desc: 九门讲述了长沙风云再起之时，张启山（陈伟霆 饰）与吴老狗（曾舜晞 饰）强强连手，携手霍仙姑（陈瑶 饰）与九门诸人共赴冒险奇局一桩401部队的神秘失踪事件，牵出百年尘封的惊天秘辛生死抉择兄弟之情门派担当与家国大义相互交织九门众人用热血和牺牲，守护家园，共渡难关

programme.title: 美食强人
programme.desc: 由名厨权威品评食家真实试炼，四十间餐厅角逐十强美食代表！视帝陈豪视后龚嘉欣化身美食强人，以焗猪扒饭云吞面西多士乳鸽汉堡包虾饺等十大主题，严选大湾区最强美食指南

programme.title: 娱乐头条
programme.desc: 每晚紧贴香港娱乐圈的消息，以至世界各地的影视娱乐新闻，报导艺人最新动态剧集和电影宣传演唱会精华颁奖礼盛况等，甚至远赴外地采访娱乐盛事追踪各地影星，专访观众熟悉的歌影视红人，让大家瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈的动态和最新消息

programme.title: 晚间新闻
programme.desc: 报导香港两岸国际重要新闻以及体育消息，让你洞悉各地大事及体坛动向

programme.title: 香港人在北京 第1集
programme.desc: 物业管理公司高层徐港仁陈展鹏饰藉运气帮助，事业一帆风顺，却与太太邝海伦吴若希饰误堕投资骗局，损失惨重港仁获派往北京分公司出任CEO，视之为翻身机会，遂偕海伦北上发展，怎料遇中年危机港仁因昔日宿敌丁志强明升暗降，为面子被迫留守；他及后亦重遇多年不见的苏菲蔡洁饰，婚姻面临考验美食网红徐港文洪永城饰街头歌手徐宝怡戴祖仪饰各有原因北上投靠大哥港仁，一家人集思广益，想将废弃变压厂改造成文创园佛系主义的港仁，要认真为人生打场硬仗！

programme.title: 射鵰英雄传 第3集
programme.desc: 南宋中叶，郭杨两家无辜惨遭灭门，其后人各散东西，展开了一段不解的两代情仇郭家后人郭靖（张智霖）于大漠成长，为人正直坚毅，自小得江南七怪传授武艺一次南下江南，结识了精灵活脱的黄蓉（朱茵），二人展开了一段生死相许的感情及武林奇遇机缘巧合下，郭靖先后习得北丐洪七公（刘丹）之降龙十八掌及周伯通（黎耀祥）之武林绝学九阴真经，令郭靖之武艺大进那边厢，杨家后人杨康（罗嘉良）为金人完颜洪烈收养，贵为太子

programme.title: 解决师 第23集
programme.desc: 解决师协助黑帮解决终极难题，往往无所不用其极！澳洲华人黑帮解决师Karson王浩信饰，欲远离黑道与挚爱Chloe张曦雯饰一起，可惜Chole意外死亡K同时遭嫁祸杀害黑帮龙头，以假死逃避追杀，到了香港成为中学体育老师O Sir敖熙辰，展开第二人生5E班新任班主任Jovy蒋颖欣唐诗咏饰，实为黑帮龙头千金，父亲金盆洗手令黑白两道掀起巨浪，且殃及校园，O Sir逼不得已再以解决师身份，肩负保护Jovy及学生的使命

programme.title: 解决师 第24集
programme.desc: 解决师协助黑帮解决终极难题，往往无所不用其极！澳洲华人黑帮解决师Karson王浩信饰，欲远离黑道与挚爱Chloe张曦雯饰一起，可惜Chole意外死亡K同时遭嫁祸杀害黑帮龙头，以假死逃避追杀，到了香港成为中学体育老师O Sir敖熙辰，展开第二人生5E班新任班主任Jovy蒋颖欣唐诗咏饰，实为黑帮龙头千金，父亲金盆洗手令黑白两道掀起巨浪，且殃及校园，O Sir逼不得已再以解决师身份，肩负保护Jovy及学生的使命

programme.title: 十八年后的终极告白 第6集
programme.desc: 十八年前，林朗生谭俊彦饰沈敬一陈山聪饰谢家富何远东饰等七位屋邨少年，与小混混胡启思发生冲突，最终启思倒毙地上......七人互生隔阂，从此各散东西，不相往还十八年过去，警方调查一宗交通意外期间，发现启思骸骨，七子无法再逃避昔日犯下的弥天大祸！矛盾挣扎之际，朗生与负责调查骸骨案的重案组督察阮丽瑾黄智雯饰萌生情愫，内心更为困惑与此同时，丽瑾的父亲阮进林嘉华饰亦暗中追查事件，似跟骸骨有所关连随着真相逐步浮现，七子人人自危，到底谁是真凶？

programme.title: 他来自江湖 第24集
programme.desc: 明天原是黑道枭雄，因一次买卖令未婚妻意外身亡而大受打击，决洗心革面，经营联谊会为生明天与母亲舅父何英彪及表弟何鑫淼同住，英彪一直怀疑明天当年连累他被革离警队，故对他诸多单打，但明天并不介怀，鑫淼却视明天为偶像，两人情同手足，使英彪为之气结明天自未婚妻死后，本心如止水，不料邂逅余文骞及阮黛玉，感情生活泛起涟漪鑫淼为父误入歧途，牵涉入毒品买卖，明天为救鑫淼，联同警务督察旧友马世雄，与黑帮周旋

programme.desc: 解决师协助黑帮解决终极难题，往往无所不用其极！澳洲华人黑帮解决师Karson王浩信饰，欲远离黑道与挚爱Chloe张曦雯饰一起，可惜Chole意外死亡K同时遭嫁祸杀害黑帮龙头，以假死逃避追杀，到了香港成为中学体育老师O Sir敖熙辰，展开第二人生5E班新任班主任Jovy蒋颖欣唐诗咏饰，实为黑帮龙头千金，父亲金盆洗手令黑白两道掀起巨浪，且殃及校园，O Sir逼不得已再以解决师身份，肩负保护Jovy及学生的使命

programme.title: 十八年后的终极告白 第6集
programme.desc: 十八年前，林朗生谭俊彦饰沈敬一陈山聪饰谢家富何远东饰等七位屋邨少年，与小混混胡启思发生冲突，最终启思倒毙地上......七人互生隔阂，从此各散东西，不相往还十八年过去，警方调查一宗交通意外期间，发现启思骸骨，七子无法再逃避昔日犯下的弥天大祸！矛盾挣扎之际，朗生与负责调查骸骨案的重案组督察阮丽瑾黄智雯饰萌生情愫，内心更为困惑与此同时，丽瑾的父亲阮进林嘉华饰亦暗中追查事件，似跟骸骨有所关连随着真相逐步浮现，七子人人自危，到底谁是真凶？

programme.title: 他来自江湖 第24集
programme.desc: 明天原是黑道枭雄，因一次买卖令未婚妻意外身亡而大受打击，决洗心革面，经营联谊会为生明天与母亲舅父何英彪及表弟何鑫淼同住，英彪一直怀疑明天当年连累他被革离警队，故对他诸多单打，但明天并不介怀，鑫淼却视明天为偶像，两人情同手足，使英彪为之气结明天自未婚妻死后，本心如止水，不料邂逅余文骞及阮黛玉，感情生活泛起涟漪鑫淼为父误入歧途，牵涉入毒品买卖，明天为救鑫淼，联同警务督察旧友马世雄，与黑帮周旋

programme.title: 香港人在北京 第2集
programme.desc: 物业管理公司高层徐港仁陈展鹏饰藉运气帮助，事业一帆风顺，却与太太邝海伦吴若希饰误堕投资骗局，损失惨重港仁获派往北京分公司出任CEO，视之为翻身机会，遂偕海伦北上发展，怎料遇中年危机港仁因昔日宿敌丁志强明升暗降，为面子被迫留守；他及后亦重遇多年不见的苏菲蔡洁饰，婚姻面临考验美食网红徐港文洪永城饰街头歌手徐宝怡戴祖仪饰各有原因北上投靠大哥港仁，一家人集思广益，想将废弃变压厂改造成文创园佛系主义的港仁，要认真为人生打场硬仗！
